manual_review_reason: Each playlist must be selected for genuine genre fit. The final submission opens an authorized Spotify or Deezer account connection and discloses automatic following of Soundplate and designated playlists before submission. A human must review those actions, the platform terms, the selected curator and the track before consciously authorizing OAuth. No authentication, consent or automatic-follow action may be performed or bypassed by the agent.

platform: DailyPlaylists Free Standard Spotify Playlist Submission
manual_review_reason: DailyPlaylists requires a user account created with email, Google or Facebook and a connected Spotify account before music can be submitted. The track must already be released on Spotify, only an individual song can be submitted, and playlist targeting remains an editorial suitability decision. A human must authorize the account and Spotify API connection, select appropriate Standard curators, avoid optional paid credits or subscriptions unless separately approved and submit manually. No login or account boundary may be handled or bypassed by the agent.
